shortDescription: Manage volumes on Vexata VX100 storage arrays

options.name: array
options.description: Vexata VX100 array hostname or IPv4 Address.

options.name: password
options.description: Vexata API user password. Uses the E(VEXATA_PASSWORD) environment variable as a fallback.

options.name: size
options.description: Volume size in M, G, T units. M=2^20, G=2^30, T=2^40 bytes.

options.name: state
options.description: Creates/Modifies volume when present or removes when absent.

options.name: user
options.description: Vexata API user with administrative privileges. Uses the E(VEXATA_USER) environment variable as a fallback.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Allows connection when SSL certificates are not valid. Set to V(false) when certificates are not trusted. If set to V(true), please make sure Python >= 2.7.9 is installed on the given machine.
